title: Impressive company.  I needed replacement of some of my paint colors.
body: I received a Pink Picasso Kit (Pink) for Christmas.  When I opened some of the paints, they were a little dry and goopy.  I contacted Pink and let them know the color number of the paints I was having trouble with. It was less than 24 hours before they responded and to let me know they were working in the warehouse putting the paints together that I needed.  Less than 48 hours later, the paints were shipped and on their way to me.   I was sent a whole complete new set of paints!  What a nice surprise.  The shipment arrived quickly, was well packaged and no charge.  I am very pleased with my paint by number kit and the service and caring from Pink.  I would recommend them to anyone especially a novice (like I am) as they take the time to help their customers.  I feel they have a quality product with easy to follow instructions.  Very supportive!!

title: Art guild of Galveston country club
body: In the old days, our mothers used to get together and do ceramics and it brings back memories. I have a group friends that get together every week for a few hours to paint. At first we all showed up with various kits we had bought on the Internet. I brought pink Picasso one time and we all got hooked! The country club does a lot of golf and mah-jongg, but we have branched out and the art guild of Galveston country club doing our paint numbers! We all absolutely love it, but we need more selections. It’s great as we all have a little different style and they come out beautifully, but we need more choices. We love the flowers and the plants. We are going to have a gallery show at the end of the year to show off our beautiful work!
